svg.text: Print flat, 186 wide x 205 tall x 3 mm, ASA, enclosed printer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm holes 10 in from each side and from top and bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (166 x 185 apart) to match the box's four moulded bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure your box's bosses first and move the holes to suit.
